findings.problem: The space before the semicolon was U+0020; the fr guide requires the espace fine insécable U+202F before : ; ! ? in prose (372 of the catalogue's 390 semicolons already use it, and every sibling in this namespace does). A plain space sets visibly wide French punctuation and can wrap the mark to the next line.
